h: Kwankwaso says Tinubu does not deserve a second term
p: Rabiu Kwankwaso has reportedly said President Tinubu has not earned a second term in office. He pointed to the cost of living and the state of the economy as reasons. Supporters of the president have defended his reforms as necessary for long-term growth.
more: Kwankwaso is part of the opposition NDC platform alongside Peter Obi.
The APC says the economy is stabilising under the reforms.
